about_the_game:
🎮 Demo Content Included

This demo offers an introductory experience of Cardventure: JustAHead, featuring the following content:

  • Full access to Chapter 1: Black Dragon Forest and Chapter 2: Eternal Night Cavern

  • Core gameplay systems including turn-based action combat, room exploration, ability drafting, and boss battles

  • 5 basic weapons unlocked: Eyebeam Cannon, Skull Fist, Lightning Spear, Hero's Greatsword, and Divine Crossbow

  • 4 major ability archetypes available: Bomb, Lightning, Bat, and Summon

  • Complete opening storyline and character dialogues covering the first narrative arc

  • In-run ability building and out-of-run upgrade system (Soul Upgrades supported)

  • Estimated playtime: 5–10 minutes per run, replayable with diverse builds

🚫 Differences from the Full Version

  • Later content beyond Chapter 2 is not available in this demo

  • Some hidden weapons and abilities are locked

  • Additional enemies and room types are not included

  • Extended storylines are not yet available

  • The full version will be released separately upon the game's official launch

Cardventure: JustAHead! is a unique action-roguelike where you play as the decapitated yet still-conscious head of the Demon Lord, awakening on a broken throne to begin your journey of revenge and rebuilding.

Combat uses the innovative “Enemies Only Move When You Do” system—say goodbye to twitchy reflexes! No reaction speed required. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or just terrible at action games, you can still enjoy the thrill of dodging and smashing!

🎮 Key Features

  • ⚔️ Turn-Based Action Combat

    Enemies only respond after your move. Easy to control, yet offering the tension and satisfaction of a Soulslike—minus the pain. Timing, positioning, and clever planning are all that matter.

  • 🃏 A World Made of Cards

    Characters, environments, skills—everything is a card. Interact with the entire world as cards. Break conventions, build creative strategies, and fight in a whole new way.

  • 🧠 Deep Build Variety

    Launch explosive eyeball lasers. Dash through enemies with lightning lances. Punch enemies to dust with the Demon Fist...

    Mix and match hundreds of ability cards—lightning, bombs, bats, and more! Discover unexpected builds through random encounters and forge your own playstyle.

  • 🐉 Memorable Boss Fights

    Drown in a slime horde. Get outdrawn by a Lucky Hunter. Every boss has its own mechanics—observe, adapt, and strike back with style.

  • 💬 Rich Dialogue & Story

    Every character has unique dialogue and backstory. Through countless attempts, you'll gradually uncover the true secret behind the Demon Lord’s resurrection...

🌌 World Setting

Year 159 of the Holy Calendar.
The Demon Lord was slain by the Hero.
The castle lies in ruins. His minions have fled. Monsters lurk, scheming for the empty throne.

But no one knows...

You—the severed head of the Demon Lord—still draw breath.

"This is not revenge.

I'm simply taking back what's mine."

✅ Who Should Play This?

  • Players who love Hades, The Binding of Isaac, or Hollow Knight, but want less mechanical pressure and more tactical depth

  • Fans of build crafting, smart positioning, and engaging boss fights

  • Loyal followers of the Demon Lord 😈

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (OpenGL 3.2 compatible)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: This game is very lightweight and can run on almost any PC.
